# Create Web API Endpoint Skill

## Goal
Create a production-ready API endpoint.

## Workflow
1. Create request DTO
2. Add FluentValidation validator
3. Create CQRS command/query
4. Create handler
5. Add logging
6. Add endpoint/controller
7. Add integration test
8. Add Swagger documentation

## Rules
- Keep controllers thin
- Return proper HTTP status codes
- Validate all requests
- Use DTOs only
- Use centralized exception handling

## Checklist
- Validation added
- Logging added
- Status codes correct
- Endpoint secured
- Tests added
